# gitmoap_repository_release_asset (Data Source)

Download a release asset. Answers with a `302` redirect to a short-lived download link. With `?redirect=false` it answers `200 { url }` instead, for a browser app that cannot follow an authenticated redirect to another origin and navigates to the link itself.

The token needs `release:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `asset_id` (String) Asset ID
- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID
- `tag_name` (String) Tag name

### Optional

- `redirect` (Boolean) When `false`, return `200 { url }` instead of a `302`

### Read-Only

- `url` (String) A presigned URL to download the file from. It expires shortly.
